_about: Adjudication of every held-out input that did not plainly agree with an independent oracle in the 2026-10-06d run (docs/benchmark/heldout-2026-10-06d.md), all draws. reader: OpenReadout returns something wrong or incomplete, or rejects an intact file. unresolved: a disagreement no independent reader can settle yet (counted as a disagreement). oracle: the ground truth, its converter or the comparison is wrong or follows another convention. gap: the reader refuses a variant it does not support (exit 6, or exit 3 for a layout it does not recognise) with a hint. no-oracle: no usable independent ground truth. self: the only oracle is our own second implementation or a parse written for the draw. After the draw-D fixes of fix/heldout-d-findings (2026-10-06): five of the inputs whose findings were fixed and that now agree carry no class (their verdict comes from the run); ho-mtbls15503-d-6495 is oracle (746 of its 748 chromatograms are rebuilt from our scans; the probe counts the chromatograms as traces, where we return MRM transitions as scans, as D-O4); ho-mtbls14519-tdf-blank is oracle (its 1/K0 is positive and its frames equal timsrust, which approximates m/z and 1/K0 by a straight line where we apply the calibration, as D-O5); ho-gh-pilizota-plate-clariostar-growth stays reader and ho-gh-fthuld-neware-nda-old gap.
